title: Creative & Technical Content Writer
jobDescription: Creative & Technical Content Writer Disclaimer We are looking for a Creative Writer with ah keen eye for detail and the ability to thrive under pressure. Should be Excellent with Microsoft Office (PPT, Word & Excel) The Creative Writer will be constructing copy, both long and short-form, for a number of different audiences. You must be able to work well on your own and as part of a team. Any changes suggested by our editors should be timely implemented and you should know how to strike a balance between quality and quantity. Responsibilities Create Business presentations (PPT) and documents basis the requirement. Conducting research before and during the writing process. Preparing material for assignments, which includes planning, outline, and synopsis. Conducting thorough fact-checks before submitting any work. Ensuring the logical flow of all writing produced. Attending feedback sessions and making revisions suggested by the client, publisher or editors. Attending training sessions and workshops as required. ... Requirements Excellent Microsoft Office (PowerPoint presentation, Word & Excel) skills. Excellent with verbal and written English. Evidence of writing experience (links to published work would be advantageous). Critical reading and thinking skills. Resilience and the ability to accept constructive feedback. A growth mindset. Education Bachelor Degree in any stream

title: Sr. UI / FRONTEND DEVELOPER
jobDescription: Sr. UI / FRONTEND DEVELOPER Required Education and Experience: Any Bachelor Degree. 3+ years of relevant experience in developing enterprise level software. Should have good development experience in REACT, Material UI/Elastic UI. Good knowledge of CSS, HTML, Bootstrap and ElasticUI or MaterialUI Solid understanding of object-oriented programming. Experience in source code management tools such as GIT or Bitbucket. Good experience in Agile based development approach. Good to Have: Knowledge and Experience in Angular. Desired Qualities: Experience to perform Unit Testing and Integration Testing. Understand Architecture Requirements and ensure effective design, development, validation and support activities. Analyzing user requirements, envisioning system features and functionality. Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and recommend system, solutions by comparing advantages and disadvantages of custom development. Contributing to team meetings, troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms. Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies to maximize development efficiency. Excited about working for a startup and moving quickly.
